name: agent-lantern
description: A lightweight Windows overlay for remote AI agent status.

scripts.build:overlay: pnpm --filter @agent-lantern/protocol build && pnpm --filter @agent-lantern/daemon build:bundle && pnpm --filter @agent-lantern/overlay tauri:build && pnpm collect:artifacts
scripts.dev:overlay: pnpm --filter @agent-lantern/protocol build && pnpm --filter @agent-lantern/daemon build:bundle && pnpm --filter @agent-lantern/overlay tauri:dev
scripts.pack:reporter: pnpm build && pnpm --filter agent-status-reporter pack:distribution && node scripts/collect-artifacts.mjs --skip-installers
